New: Initial release of rio: a SKILL.state coding agent ported from tau, using structured execution state and the latest observation at each step (arXiv:2608.26263).
rio_ai provides the provider/model streaming layer; rio_agent runs the SKILL.state step loop; rio_coding is the CLI application, resources, skills, and RPC frontend built on top of them.
A JSONL RPC frontend (`rio_coding.rpc`) exposes the session's execution state, its state journal, and the SKILL.state step-lifecycle event stream to external frontends.
Built-in provider catalog, OAuth login, project skills and prompt templates, and project-input trust ported from tau.
Interactive Textual interface with execution-state inspection, model and session selection, local inference management, extension dialogs and widgets, and checkpoint restoration.
Coding tools, extension lifecycle hooks, HTML/JSONL exports, and deterministic integration tests.
